title: Two-Stage YOLO26 Pipeline for Tooth Instance Segmentation, Detection of Teeth with Visible Caries, and Geometric Association in Intraoral Photographs: Code and Results
description:
This repository contains the complete, reproducible computational pipeline for the study "A Two-Stage YOLO26 Pipeline for Tooth Instance Segmentation, Detection of Teeth with Visible Caries, and Geometric Association in Intraoral Photographs". It integrates three stages applied to intraoral photographs: (1) tooth instance segmentation across eight structural categories using YOLO26n/s/m-seg, (2) detection of teeth with visible caries using YOLO26n/s/m-det, and (3) a calibrated centroid–overlap geometric association procedure linking each caries detection to its corresponding segmented tooth instance.

Key results: YOLO26s-seg achieved the best segmentation performance (Mask mAP@50 = 0.9616; Mask mAP@50–95 = 0.8627) on a participant/session-verified test set of 244 images. The geometric association procedure (τ = 0.10; δ = 0.02) achieved an accuracy of 0.9909 and a coverage of 0.9858 over 777 evaluated detections.

This is a computer-vision feasibility study. Reported metrics describe algorithmic performance with respect to the reference annotations used and do not constitute clinical validation or diagnostic evidence.
